mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_session (user_id, title, provider, model, document_id, last_message_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{provider}, #{model}, #{documentId}, #{lastMessageAt})
mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.user_id, s.title, s.provider, s.model, s.document_id, s.last_message_at, s.created_at, s.updated_at, (SELECT LEFT(m.content, 40) FROM chat_message m WHERE m.session_id = s.id ORDER BY m.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_message FROM chat_session s WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY COALESCE(s.last_message_at, s.created_at) DESC, s.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_session SET title = #{title} WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
